sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Trade Intermediary and Commercial Re-Invoicing Operations

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid legal system comprising a written constitution, statutory corporate law modeled on United States jurisprudence, applicable common law principles, and customary law elements.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America, signed 1986, Amended Compact 2003, including certain economic and investment-related provisions
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), signed 2017
No comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTAA) is currently in force as of the due diligence date

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended); Business Corporations Act, 17 MIRC 101 et seq. (as amended); Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2012; Beneficial Ownership Regulations and Guidance issued by the Registrar of Corporations and the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of each beneficial owner's current international passport (and secondary government-issued identification when applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing state authority / passport office of the beneficial owner's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille in the country of issuance; for jurisdictions outside the Hague Apostille Convention, full Consular Legalization through the competent nearest consular/embassy channel.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified current proof of residential address for each beneficial owner, director and officer (bank statement or public utility bill not older than three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank, utility company, or competent municipal authority in the jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy bearing Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization where foreign issuance is involved.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent foreign corporate extract for any direct corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issued in certified form and legalized by Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization depending on the competent authority jurisdictions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly executed Power of Attorney and Authorized Signatory List in favor of the Marshall Islands licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution or the corporate board of directors of the ultimate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and subsequent Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization before filing with the Marshall Islands corporate services provider.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, beneficial owners and authorized signatories against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, European Union and United Kingdom sanctions lists, and the domestic Marshall Islands Attorney General's sanctions and criminal watch list records. Screening is also required against recognized PEP databases, adverse media sources, and global beneficial ownership risk matrices. Results must be documented, retained by the registered agent for a minimum of five years after termination of the business relationship, and escalated immediately to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit in the event of a positive match.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations e-Filing and Registered Agent Portal (no direct public self-service web portal; all name reservations are submitted electronically through a licensed resident registered agent)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names are maintained in the English-language register using Latin characters. There is no statutory transliteration system for non-Latin scripts; therefore any desired foreign-language name must be rendered in an English transliteration approved by the registered agent and must be distinguishable from all active names on the register. Arabic, Cyrillic, Chinese or other scripts may appear only as an auxiliary trading name and not as the legal corporate name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar of Corporations rejects a desired company name, the licensed registered agent may submit a written request for reconsideration within ten business days of the rejection notice, specifying why the name is distinguishable and not prohibited. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may file a formal administrative appeal with the Minister responsible for the corporate registry within twenty-one days of the affirmation, attaching the rejection letter and the supporting legal argument. A further judicial review may be initiated in the High Court of the Marshall Islands within thirty days of the final administrative disposition.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A non-resident Business Corporation is required to maintain a statutory registered office at the physical address of its licensed Marshall Islands registered agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands. A virtual office service provided by a licensed corporate services company is acceptable as a correspondence and compliance address, but it may not replace the statutory substance of the registered agent's physical office and the responsible officer of the registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated annual unannounced on-site inspection probability is low, approximately 0–5%, for a non-resident re-invoicing entity with no physical local footprint. However, due to the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML/CFT tier and the ISIC 4690 general re-invoicing trade scope, the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar may exercise enhanced inspection rights over the registered agent's client file, with effective inspection likelihood increasing to 10–15% in the presence of higher-risk payment rails, politically exposed persons, or complex multi-jurisdictional ownership structures.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations (via licensed registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark at approximately 1.5 hours of licensed agent processing time plus registrar communication fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and/or consular legalization handling for all pre-incorporation documents, including powers of attorney and UBO due diligence file documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent foreign authentication authority and RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs / registered agent authentication department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing government tariff schedule plus courier and legalization service market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enhanced UBO identification, authentication, and ownership chain verification for each 25% beneficial owner and senior management personnel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/CFT compliance officer of the licensed registered agent and professional due diligence service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for enhanced due diligence on an offshore trade intermediation legal form

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, sanctions, adverse media, and global watchlist screening per beneficial owner, director, officer, and authorized signatory (assumed five screened individuals)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Third-party sanctions screening database provider and registered agent's AML compliance function
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-person subscription database market benchmark at approximately $20 per screened individual

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Marshall Islands Business Corporation incorporation filing fee for a non-resident, tax-exempt business corporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff applicable to Business Corporations Act incorporations payable at filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Appointment of Marshall Islands licensed registered agent and statutory registered office for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing annual professional registered agent fee market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation of Bylaws, initial corporate resolutions, share issuance records, and board consent approving the re-invoicing business scope
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI corporate legal counsel / law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional legal fee benchmark for an offshore Business Corporation with standard authorized share capital

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation and authentication of any existing foreign corporate registry documents of parent or intermediate corporate shareholders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translation provider and authentication/legalization public officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark rate per document batch and certification page

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, 1990, as amended, codified as Title 20 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (20 MIRC Tit. 20); formation and governance authority derives principally from the incorporation chapter (20 MIRC Secs. 101 et seq.), the registered agent and registered office provisions (20 MIRC Secs. 201 et seq.), the shares and capital provisions (20 MIRC Secs. 301 et seq.), and the directors and officers provisions (20 MIRC Secs. 401 et seq.).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll MH 96960; document intake and filing administration are coordinated through International Registries, Inc. (IRI), the Republic's authorized corporate registry administrative agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation filed with the Registrar of Corporations; the official formation document issued upon approval is the Certificate of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement. A non-resident Business Corporation may be incorporated with nominal authorized capital and zero issued shares. Standard practice for a re-invoicing hub is US$50,000 authorized capital divided into shares at a nominal par value; shares may not be issued below par, consideration is fixed by the board, and the subscription price may be deferred until called.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of the Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, as evidenced by the Certificate of Incorporation of the Registrar, is hereby ratified, confirmed, and adopted. RESOLVED, that the authorized shares be and the same are hereby issued to the subscriber named in the Articles in full consideration of the subscription price. RESOLVED, that the registered office and registered agent designated in the Articles be and the same are hereby approved and maintained. RESOLVED, that the following persons be and are hereby elected directors, and the directors hereby appoint the President, the Secretary, and the Treasurer of the Corporation; all incorporation expenses be and are hereby ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro, administered through International Registries, Inc. (IRI) corporate registry desks.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request with three ranked corporate name options, each containing a distinctive element and a recognized corporate suffix such as Corporation, Incorporated, or Limited. The Registrar screens the proposed names against the corporate registry index for deceptive similarity. Upon reservation, retain the name reservation confirmation reference for use in the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request form
Three ranked corporate name options
Certified copy of incorporator passport and proof of address for AML/KYC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is rejected for deceptive similarity, file an administrative objection accompanied by the written consent of the registered owner, or immediately re-submit the second-ranked name; the reservation carries a 30-day priority period against third-party capture.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator acting through a licensed Marshall Islands formation agent or registered agent; notarization in the place of execution.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation specifying the corporate name, the registered office address in the Marshall Islands, the registered agent, the general purpose of offshore commercial re-invoicing and trade intermediation, the authorized capital structure, and the name and address of the incorporator. Execute the Articles before a notary public and concurrently adopt the Bylaws. Obtain the registered agent's executed consent to act and prepare a share subscription statement for the initial subscriber.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation (original)
Bylaws of the Business Corporation
Consent of Registered Agent to Act
Share Subscription Statement
AML/KYC file of the incorporator and any beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition for defective objects clauses or an irregular capital description, file a certificate of correction or re-file a corrected Articles of Incorporation within the response period without loss of priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing with the Registrar and Payment of Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro, with fee remittance through authorized depositaries.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the executed and notarized Articles of Incorporation, the registered agent consent, the name reservation confirmation, and the government filing fee of USD 500 for the standard US$50,000 authorized capital band to the Registrar of Corporations. Upon satisfaction of the statutory conditions, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the corporate number, formation date, and official seal, at which point the Business Corporation becomes a separate legal person.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Consent of Registered Agent to Act
Government fee remittance advice
Name reservation confirmation
Cover letter from the formation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for defective execution, fee shortfall, or name conflict, the Registrar issues a formal requisition; cure by filing a certificate of correction, paying the differential fee, or amending the name within the 30-day cure period before deemed withdrawal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Business Corporation, acting by unanimous written consent without a meeting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organizational meeting or circulate the pro-forma First Board Resolution for unanimous written consent. The board ratifies the incorporation, approves the subscription and issuance of shares to the incorporator, adopts the registered office and registered agent, elects the directors, appoints the President, the Secretary, and the Treasurer, and ratifies all incorporation expenses. Each officer executes an acceptance and the corporate records book is opened.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma First Board Resolution
Unanimous Written Consent in lieu of meeting or executed minutes
Share certificates
Officer acceptance forms
Shareholders register and directors register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent identifies a defect in the share issue, such as an over-issue beyond the authorized capital, re-execute the consent with a corrective share allotment and amend the share register; no public filing is required for interior corporate records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Filings and Registry Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent in the Marshall Islands and the Office of the Registrar of Corporations for public filings affecting the registered agent or registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Business Corporation must continuously maintain a Marshall Islands registered agent and registered office. The registered agent maintains the statutory registers of shareholders, directors, and officers at its approved location. Any change of registered agent or registered office, or any amendment to the Articles of Incorporation, must be filed with the Registrar before the change becomes effective against third parties.
required_dossiers: Registered agent and registered office address confirmation
Statutory registers of shareholders, directors, and officers
Certificate of Incumbency application, if required
Annual compliance calendar and renewal reminders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to maintain a registered agent may trigger administrative dissolution under the Business Corporations Act; cure by immediate re-appointment of a qualified agent and payment of the reinstatement fee and any penalty before the Registrar publishes the strike-off notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License, Physical and Environmental Clearance Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Majuro Atoll Local Government Business License Section for any future physical office; Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands for any future environmental threshold activity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For a pure offshore re-invoicing intermediary conducting no warehousing, manufacturing, or environmental discharge in the Marshall Islands, no operating license is statutorily required and no EIA filing is triggered. If a physical representative office is later opened in Majuro, obtain a municipal business license and an occupancy and fire safety clearance for the office. If any future material storage or logistics activity commences, obtain the applicable EPA registration and a waste management plan before operations.
required_dossiers: Not applicable; no statutory license mandated for the pure re-invoicing model
If physical office: lease agreement, floor plan, and fire safety certificate
If future warehouse: EPA registration form and waste management plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality asserts licensing jurisdiction over a future physical office, apply for the appropriate trade license retroactively and cure any penalty by evidencing the non-resident tax-exempt character of the entity; any EPA registration, if triggered, is subject to a 15-business-day technical review.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) – Ministry of Finance, Treasury and Accounting, Revenue and Taxation Division (administering the Income Tax Act 1989, Title 40 of the RMI Code); corporate registry administered by the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General. Official portal: www.rmigovernment.org; no fully integrated e-filing or e-registration platform exists – filings are paper or manually presented. Note: The artificially supplied alpha-3 code 'PNG' is a dataset artifact; the correct ISO-3166 alpha-3 code for the RMI is 'MHL'.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The RMI does not operate a general statutory TIN or VAT ID issuance regime. A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) is incorporated under the Business Corporations Act and is not registered for tax unless it derives gross income from sources within the RMI. A Foreign Investment Business License under the Foreign Investment Business Act may be voluntarily obtained but is not required for a purely offshore re-invoicing BC with no local place of business. Where a U.S. bank needs an FTIN/EIN, the BC obtains a U.S. EIN via IRS Form SS-4. Only if the BC earns RMI-source gross revenue does the Revenue and Taxation Division assign a gross receipts tax account number. Consequently, for the standard non-resident MH_BC, no domestic tax ID is issued; a Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar of Corporations is the operative identity document.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (territorial-scope entity-level taxation; no RMI-source revenue = 0% effective rate; no domestic pass-through election exists).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The Income Tax Act 1989 provides no domestic check-the-box, consolidation, fit, hybrid-mismatch, or deemed-tax election mechanism. There is also no statutory election to voluntarily submit to RMI gross revenue tax. The only available mechanism of consequence is the U.S. federal Form 8832 entity-classification election, which may classify the BC as a disregarded entity or a partnership for U.S. tax purposes, subject to hybrid and BEAT considerations. No RMI filing is required to perfect such an election, and the RMI Tax Treaty network (none) does not affect it.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None. The RMI has no VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax statute. The only indirect-type levies are customs import tariffs under the Customs Tariff Act and specific excises on alcohol, tobacco, and fuel; these apply exclusively to goods physically entered for consumption in the RMI and cannot touch a pure offshore re-invoicing transaction.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no indirect-tax (VAT/GST) regime and therefore no economic turnover threshold exists for indirect-tax registration. For customs purposes, an importer registration applies to any person landing goods in the RMI without a monetary de minimis threshold, but the MH_BC offshore re-invoicing hub, whose goods/services never physically touch RMI territory, has zero registration obligation. The functional local currency is the U.S. dollar (USD).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The RMI imposes no e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, tax-authority API approval, or SAF-T reporting mandate. RMI Customs operates on paper-based manifests and an advance shipping/environmental authorization channel; no fiscal telemetry applies to the MH_BC's invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Statutory zero-rating is not applicable because no VAT/GST exists to zero-rate. The functional equivalent is territorial exclusion: under the Income Tax Act 1989, gross revenue tax reaches only gross income sourced within the Republic. Re-invoicing services rendered to non-residents entirely offshore, and goods that are never imported into RMI customs territory, are excluded from the tax base and attract 0% tax without any refund claim. Where physical cargo transits RMI ports solely in transit, it qualifies for the transshipment/in-transit exemption from import duty. Substantiation relies on the commercial file proving no RMI-sourced activity, not on a fiscal refund mechanism.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (RMI Customs Form CED-1) – required only for physical exports leaving RMI ports; not triggered by pure offshore re-invoicing where goods never enter RMI
Bill of Lading or House Air Waybill evidencing the underlying physical shipment and the re-invoicing corridor
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 credit advice evidencing settlement of the re-invoiced trade receivable
Transit Cargo Manifest (RMI Customs Form T-1) – required only where cargo is transshipped through Majuro or Ebeye ports in transit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no VAT zero-rating clawback because no VAT is collected. The enforceable risk stack is instead: (i) recharacterization of income as RMI-source by the Revenue and Taxation Division, triggering the 3% gross revenue tax plus interest at 8% per annum and penalties up to 25% of the tax due under Section 124 of the Income Tax Act; (ii) customs duty evasion penalties under the Customs Tariff Act for undervaluation or false transit declarations, including forfeiture of goods, fines of up to double the duty evaded, and criminal liability for fraudulent documentation; (iii) loss of the tax-exempt characterization if the BC maintains a physical office, employees, or performs services inside the RMI, which would establish RMI-source nexus; and (iv) the 180-day FX repatriation benchmark, which is not an RMI statutory deadline but a lender/AML substance metric, is tested by auditors as part of economic-substance and trade-finance files.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Republic of the Marshall Islands (administrative oversight under the Marshall Islands Banking Act, with the US Federal Reserve as the de facto monetary authority due to official dollarization; no domestic central bank exists)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The US dollar is the sole legal tender, and there are no exchange controls or capital account restrictions; current and capital account transactions are fully convertible. Profit remittance is unrestricted subject to corporate good standing, tax clearance, and AML/CFT-compliant sourcing documentation. No mandatory conversion or repatriation approval is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No export proceeds surrender requirement exists; all trade receipts may be retained in USD, repatriated freely, or used offshore. The statutory timeline is zero days, and the mandatory conversion ratio is 0%. Beneficiaries must, however, satisfy anti-money-laundering record-keeping duties under the Marshall Islands Banking Act and the Currency and Financial Transactions Reporting Act.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD current account for trade disbursements)
Operational Account / Capital Escrow Account (where locally required)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility is Low for full treasury reliance: non-resident offshore digital EMIs are not subject to Marshall Islands banking regulation, lack deposit insurance or domestic branch presence, and face elevated AML/CFT scrutiny for re-invoicing hubs. They may be used only as auxiliary clearing channels for non-core low-value transfers, with all statutory records mirrored at a domestic bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally required for directors and beneficial owners during initial onboarding; remote opening is permitted only for existing bank clients with a previous in-person due-diligence file and a certified apostilled corporate package. For new non-resident entities, at least one director or authorized signatory must appear in person (or before a recognized correspondent bank) to satisfy the 'face-to-face' verification requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Re-invoicing jurisdiction with no physical office, staff, or independent business evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copies of master trade contracts, underlying purchase orders, freight and insurance documents, warehouse/third-party logistics agreements, and a board resolution authorizing the re-invoicing model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Very high transaction velocity relative to stated capital and operational profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month audited management accounts, forecast cash-flow model, counterparty transaction registers, KYC files on each end-buyer and end-supplier, and copies of export/import customs declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership chains involving trusts, foundations, or multiple intermediate holding vehicles in low-tax jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full organogram listing each layer of ownership, certified trust deeds, foundation statutes, registers of directors/members, and source-of-wealth affidavits with supporting investment or sale documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to or from sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions without clear commercial rationale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive sanctions screening logs, transaction-specific commercial invoices with Incoterms, letters of credit or SWIFT MT700 records, and legal counsel confirmation that the transaction does not involve persons on the OFAC/EU/UN sanctions lists.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed via correspondent US-dollar clearing networks (e.g., CHIPS or Fedwire) to the Marshall Islands bank's USD nostro account. The SWIFT MT103 field 50K/52D must name the ultimate transferring entity, field 59 must show the Beneficiary Business Corporation account, and the payment narrative (field 70) must include 'CAPITAL INJECTION – SHAREHOLDER SUBSCRIPTION' and a corporate resolution reference. Acceptable purpose codes are 'General corporate capital increase' (IMF BOP code E512) or 'Other equity capital injections,' and sufficient evidence of the capital origin must be held on file.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements should primarily use SWIFT MT103 for low-value direct transfers and Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700/MT707) for high-value or documentary-matched transactions. The Marshall Islands account bank issues MT103 cover payments through its US correspondent; trade usance drafts are discounted only with a confirmed LC from a prime OECD bank. All settlements must reference the underlying commercial invoice, Incoterms, and re-invoicing margin. Local clearing via ACH is not used because trade counterparties are outside the Marshall Islands.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/USD (not applicable due to full dollarization; no domestic FX market)
Offshore USD/CNH deliverable forwards for trade re-invoicing against renminbi-denominated suppliers
USD/EUR non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) cleared through a licensed international bank
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) to hedge long-term re-invoicing receivables against EUR, JPY, or GBP
FX forwards executed under ISDA agreements with a US or Singapore counterparty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and annual government fee renewal for non-resident Business Corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filed through the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based: the renewal is due in the anniversary month of the original incorporation effective date; no uniform December 31 tax return is filed for non-resident activities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a penalty of US$100 per month or part thereof up to a statutory maximum of US$1,000; continued delinquency for two consecutive renewal cycles permits the Registrar to administratively dissolve the corporation and strike it from the Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual verification and availability of statutory registers and beneficial ownership register for inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations (inspection and production on demand; no routine filing is made)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Registers must be current upon annual report filing and must be produced to the Registrar within 14 days of a written inspection demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or produce statutory registers is a regulatory offense subject to fines and, in repeated default, a supporting ground for administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit threshold applies to a non-resident Business Corporation engaged in general re-invoicing trade. An independent audit is compulsory only if required by the articles of incorporation, by board resolution, or by a banking, insurance, or trust license, otherwise the accounts may remain unaudited.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act requires books and records that fairly reflect transactions and financial position; no separate RMI local GAAP is codified. IFRS is the internationally accepted benchmark, and US GAAP is commonly used for US-managed non-resident corporations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no public UBO register in the Marshall Islands. The non-resident Business Corporation must keep a private beneficial ownership register at the registered office or with the registered agent, update it within 15 days after any share transfer causing a registrable change, and confirm the accuracy of the shareholder and UBO information as part of the annual report cycle.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3.00% of gross income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands; 0% effective statutory rate for a Qualifying Non-Resident Domestic Corporation holding BCCA non-resident status with no RMI-source income
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory exemption from income tax for Non-Resident Domestic Corporations; territorial/source-based taxation with complete exclusion of foreign-source gross receipts; no capital gains tax; no alternative minimum tax; no branch remittance tax; no gross receipts or business license tax for the non-resident trade intermediary; annual government registration franchise fee substitutes for income tax

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Corporate Income Tax Return (Revenue and Taxation Form C-1) filed with the RMI Revenue and Taxation Office; no fully integrated national e-filing portal exists, so paper filing with official receipt is accepted; Non-Resident Domestic Corporations alternatively file the Annual Exemption Declaration with the RMI Registrar of Corporations and rely on the statutory exemption
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the last day of the fourth month following the close of the corporation's fiscal year (e.g., a December 31 fiscal year-end is due April 30); the Revenue and Taxation Office may grant extensions in its discretion

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporation name, BCCA registration number, registered agent, registered office in Majuro, fiscal year-end, primary ISIC activity code, and resident/non-resident status election
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the RMI registered agent and registered office; mark 'Non-Resident Domestic Corporation'; attach the Certificate of Non-Resident Status and declaration of no RMI-source business

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue, gross income derived from sources within the RMI, and foreign-source income separately disclosed with a source-of-income statement
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report US$0 or nil RMI-source income; schedule foreign purchase and re-invoicing margins as excluded items; maintain supporting contracts, invoices, and shipping documents for audit

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exemption election for Non-Resident Domestic Corporations and exclusion of foreign-source income under the territorial rules of MIRC Title 36
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cite the BCCA non-resident domestic corporation provision; confirm no trade or business conducted within the RMI, no RMI real property, no RMI employment, and no RMI-source sales

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable rate (3.00%) applied to RMI-source gross income; tax liability, payments, credits, and balance due or refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Computed tax liability is US$0 for an exempt non-resident entity; report zero in the tax-due box and attach the exemption certificate

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of an authorized director or officer, date, and capacity; certification that the return is true and complete
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The signatory must be an actual director or authorized person; willful false declarations attract criminal sanctions against the signatory personally

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% per month or fraction thereof, up to 25% of the tax due; late payment penalty of 0.5% per month up to 25%; civil negligence penalty up to 75% and civil fraud penalty up to 100% of the deficiency; willful failure to file or evasion is a criminal offense carrying fines and imprisonment; the RMI Registrar may also strike the company for persistent non-filing

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Annual Report and Non-Resident Exemption Declaration (Registrar of Corporations, BCCA annual filing) - supplementary to the tax return and required to preserve non-resident status
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing before the anniversary date of incorporation or within the period stated in the BCCA annual report regulations; the declaration of non-resident status must be renewed annually

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, registration number, jurisdiction of incorporation, registered agent endorsement, and current directors and officers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List directors with nationality and tax residence; non-resident corporations require at least one director and one president/secretary, natural or corporate; all may be foreign

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the corporation has no RMI-source business, no RMI real property, and no RMI employment activities during the year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any change in activities (e.g., opening a Majuro office, hiring local staff, owning RMI real property) converts the entity to resident status and exposes it to the 3% gross income tax

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of the RMI registered office and licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must be a licensed RMI agent; failure to maintain an agent results in administrative dissolution

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual report penalty imposed by the Registrar; administrative dissolution and reinstatement fees for failure to maintain non-resident status; directors who continue trading after dissolution incur personal liability

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by a Business Corporation, whether to residents, non-residents, or foreign corporate shareholders; no dividend tax of any kind is levied at the corporate or shareholder level
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI maintains no comprehensive double tax agreement network and has no domestic mechanism for treaty relief claims; there is no RMI-source dividend withholding to refund or reduce. Where a foreign jurisdiction grants unilateral foreign tax credits or treaty benefits, the entity may apply to the RMI Revenue and Taxation Office for a Certificate of Tax Residence and/or Certificate of Tax Exempt Status (approximately US$250 filing fee, one to three weeks processing). The certificate confirms RMI tax residence and the nil-tax classification, enabling reliance on foreign credit provisions; it does not create treaty benefits. Foreign shareholders of an RMI BC must assess CFC, Subpart F, PFIC, or substance rules in their own jurisdiction before relying on the RMI certificate
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and effective rate on outbound interest and royalties paid by an RMI Business Corporation to non-residents; royalties and interest payments made to non-resident recipients are excluded from RMI-source income when the payer conducts no trade or business within the RMI; no domestic withholding tax return or remittance obligation applies to such payments

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None - the RMI has no transfer pricing documentation statute, no Local File or Master File threshold, no contemporaneous documentation obligation, no advance pricing agreement mechanism, and no country-by-country reporting requirement under domestic law; arm's-length allocation principles exist only as general source-allocation guidance under MIRC Title 36 and are not enforced against non-resident domestic corporations with nil RMI-source income
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No domestic Economic Substance Regulations statute has been enacted for non-resident Business Corporations. However, the EU has classified the Marshall Islands as a non-cooperative jurisdiction for tax purposes (grey-listed and subsequently black-listed), and the OECD/G20 BEPS Inclusive Framework harmful tax practice peer review continues to demand substance reforms. In practice, an RMI BC engaged in general re-invoicing must maintain economic substance where the beneficial owner's jurisdiction applies CFC, controlled-foreign-company, or substance-over-form rules. Documentary substance protocol: physical office space and board minutes in the RMI or a recognized substance jurisdiction; decision-making exercised by directors with actual authority; local administrative staff; bank accounts opened in a reputable correspondent-banking jurisdiction; contracts, purchase orders, invoices, bills of lading, and treasury records retained for at least seven years; the company must not be a strato/domicile-only vehicle

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Booking fabricated intermediary margins in the RMI BC while all economic functions (sourcing, pricing, credit risk, treasury, and invoicing) are executed from a headquarters abroad; routing invoices through the RMI solely to shift profit into a zero-tax jurisdiction; issuing back-to-back invoices without genuine purchase and resale risk; failure to disclose the arrangement to foreign tax authorities as a reportable cross-border arrangement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under MIRC Title 36, willful evasion attracts a civil fraud penalty of 100% of the deficiency plus interest, a criminal fine of up to US$10,000, and imprisonment of up to five years; the RMI Registrar may dissolve the BC and revoke non-resident status; foreign jurisdictions may recharacterize the transaction, deny deduction of interposed margins, and impose 20-40% accuracy-related penalties on the taxpayer
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil where the entity is a pure instrumentality; directors who sign false returns or direct sham invoicing are personally assessed for the tax, jointly and severally; criminal conviction carries disqualification from serving as a director, asset seizure, extradition or travel bans, and imprisonment applicable both in the RMI and in the beneficial owner's jurisdiction

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the RMI BC as a mailing address only, with nominee directors who exercise no control, no board minutes, no substance in the RMI or the intermediate holding jurisdiction, no separate bank account, and no regard to OECD BEPS Action 5; using a single RMI entity for multi-jurisdiction re-invoicing without intercompany agreements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Registrar administrative strike-off and dissolution for failure to maintain registered agent or annual filings; loss of limited liability for transactions after dissolution; foreign tax authorities may disregard the entity and reattribute all profits to the controlling shareholder; inclusion in EU and OECD adverse lists triggers mandatory disclosure and penalty regimes, enhanced audit risk, and refusal of correspondent banking services
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue trading after strike-off are personally liable for debts of the dissolved company; nominee directors and beneficial owners may be subjected to travel restrictions, direct foreign tax assessments under look-through rules, criminal prosecution for money laundering in the country of effective management, and sequestration of personal assets

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML, KYC, and Unlicensed Payment Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the re-invoicing hub with no RMI or host-jurisdiction AML compliance program; accepting payments from unknown third parties or unvetted counterparties; commingling client funds; acting as an unlicensed money services business or payments intermediary without the required license; processing SWIFT LC, telegraphic wire, or XT transfers on behalf of parties without identifying the beneficial owner
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act (as amended 2018) carry fines of up to US$150,000 per violation, suspension or revocation of the entity's registration, mandatory disclosure to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, and inclusion on FinCEN or FATF advisory lists with consequential banking exclusion; the RMI's offshore finance law may also impose criminal penalties on the regulated agent
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and beneficial owners face criminal money-laundering charges with imprisonment of up to fifteen years, personal fines, asset freezing, civil forfeiture of bank accounts, and travel bans; repeated violations pierce the corporate veil, allowing creditors and regulators to reach personal assets; regulatory disqualification from managing any RMI company is automatic upon conviction
